This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title block.

This FIP Bus Controller (FBC) 
is a two channel bus controller that occupies a single slot in an IC697 
MFCVME Integrator rack. The FBC is configured with Windows* based programming 
software. I/O devices on the FIP bus are scanned asynchronously by the bus 
controller; I/O data is transferred to the CPU once per scan.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Tawfeeq, tested by 
eng. Bahaa Abd El-Wahab, revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Adel El Nagga, accepted by 
general manager eng. Mohamed Elshreif, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan head sector 
of Nubaria power station .

This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gillil 
MDEPC quality control general manager and MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb 
quality control head sector.

items:
Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained and qualified.

Caution marks must be 
 hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work place.

First, make sure rack power is turned off. Then, use a medium-blade, slotted 
 screwdriver to loosen the top and bottom holding screws just enough to free 
 the module from the rack. Note: Screws are held captive in the module, so they 
 do not have to be removed from the module.

Grasp the board firmly at the top and bottom of the board cover with your 
 thumbs on the front of the cover and your fingers on the plastic rack clips on 
 the back of the cover.

Squeeze the rack clips on the back of the cover with your fingers to disengage 
 the clips from the rack rail, and then pull the board firmly toward you until 
 it clears the rack.

Features
Interfaces FIP or World 
 FIP I/O serial bus to C80-75 MFC.
Data rate for 
 IC687BEM742 is 1 Mbit/second,
Two FIP Bus Controllers 
 per MFC system.
Two FIP bus channels 
 provide redundant bus capability.
RS485 serial port 
 attaches to PC for easy insystem firmware upgrade (no PROMS to change).
Pushbutton for resetting 
 Bus Controller and enabling Bus Controller to accept upgrades.
FIP bus faults managed 
 by MFC Alarm processor Function.
Six status LEDs.
Software configuration (no DIP switches or jumpers to set)
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be 
 hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work place.
Removing a Module
First, make sure rack power is turned off. Then, use a medium-blade, slotted 
 screwdriver to loosen the top and bottom holding screws just enough to free 
 the module from the rack. Note: Screws are held captive in the module, so they 
 do not have to be removed from the module.
Grasp the board firmly at the top and bottom of the board cover with your 
 thumbs on the front of the cover and your fingers on the plastic rack clips on 
 the back of the cover.
Squeeze the rack clips on the back of the cover with your fingers to disengage 
 the clips from the rack rail, and then pull the board firmly toward you until 
 it clears the rack.

and Equipment
